_about: Under-2-minute cut (Dec 2026): hook -> build -> sealed prediction -> Ledgerly v1 -> v2 flip -> TRIBE (short) -> panel -> measured numbers -> outro. Numbers from eval/results.md and graph/tour.cypher. Spans are [start, end, speed] in seconds of the raw recording.

scenes.html:
You pitched. The CFO said no.
You could have known.

BrainPrint · persona brains in one Relate graph
scenes.say: You pitch to a CFO and an investor, and they both say no. What if you could have asked them first?

scenes.label: Build a brain by talking
scenes.say: BrainPrint builds a brain of a person from their own words. Every belief keeps the exact quote behind it, and the brain learns how that person talks.

scenes.label: Sealed prediction
scenes.say: Before I answer, the brain locks in its prediction. It is stored in the graph first, so it cannot cheat. It predicted agree, and it was right.

scenes.label: Pitch v1, point by point
scenes.say: Here is my first pitch, tested point by point. The jargon and the funding ask put off the investor and the CFO.

scenes.label: Pitch v2: the flip
scenes.say: Version two names one real result: two hundred freelancers saved four hours a month. That point lands with all four brains, and the student brain shows why. Concrete numbers convince it.

scenes.label: Average brain (TRIBE v2)
scenes.say: Meta's TRIBE v2 adds how an average brain responds. That line lifts attention.

scenes.label: Ask every brain at once
scenes.say: Then ask every brain at once. Each answers in its own voice, citing its own beliefs, and a synthesis finds a solution for everyone.
